name: goods_category
description: The main category of the goods listed in each probate inventory, and whether they include luxury goods.

questions.name: main_category
questions.instructions: Which category of goods makes up most of the appraised value?

choices.household_furnishings: Furniture, bedding, kitchenware and other household goods.
choices.clothing_and_linen: Clothes, linen and textiles for the household.
choices.tools_and_stock_in_trade: Tools, materials and goods held for a trade or shop.
choices.livestock_and_produce: Animals, crops, grain and farm equipment.
choices.money_and_debts: Cash, plate held as money, and debts owed to the deceased.

questions.name: luxury
questions.instructions: The listed goods include luxury goods, such as silver, jewellery, porcelain, clocks, paintings or books.
